images.caption: Figure 1:StreamEval overview.Five tasks span avatar interaction, world generation, and real-time video editing. Avatar panels show recorded frames; the world-generation panel illustrates a scenario. Editing uses a shared source video with text instructions or reference images that change over time.

Figure 2:Benchmark construction and verification.Model-assisted authoring and input synthesis precede modality-specific checks. A Qwen-Image portrait with hand defects is regenerated and passes the same screening.

Figure 4:Evaluation workflow.Recorded inputs and output frames from reference-editing case 234 illustrate quality, stability, reference, and preservation checks. Fixed rules convert structured VLM observations into run metric scores. Aggregation averages repeats, conditions, and duration strata before computingtask-specific Overall.

Figure 5:Reference editing under changing inputs.Reference A is preloaded, B arrives at 10 s, and removal is requested at 20 s. Columns pair source and output frames at recorded session times. Insets magnify the outlined cape regions, showing grey retained in both B-phase outputs instead of therequested gold satin.
